targetDefinition: sum of effective units sold for t+1..t+h; net cancellations under the frozen same-day cancellation convention

fields.name: localDate
fields.notes: Lima local calendar day; timestamps stored separately in UTC

fields.name: unitsSold
fields.notes: Effective units sold; main forecasting target

fields.name: unitsDemandedSynthetic
fields.notes: Offline latent requested units; never a production feature or primary target

fields.name: lostDemandSynthetic
fields.notes: Requested minus sold under stockout; synthetic truth only

fields.name: announcedSalePriceAtOrigin
fields.notes: Only if price was known/announced by origin; PEN cents

fields.name: realizedSalePrice
fields.notes: Effective realized price for reporting; not substituted for unavailable future price

fields.name: holidayCode
fields.notes: Published holiday calendar; no unannounced synthetic pulse

fields.name: effectiveUnitCostAtSale
fields.notes: Historical accounting value; future cost is not known unless announced

leakageRules: No seed, latent popularity, secret mission, future shock, latent uplift, future sales, or lostDemandSynthetic enters model inputs.
Features and preprocessing are fitted within chronological train folds only.
Calendar covariates are known; synthetic event pulses require announcement before origin.
Observed ending stock and realized promotion/price outcomes are post-day fields.
